text:
Maria Chen: quick heads-up, I found a legacy service account key in plaintext inside a retained staging log file from last month. not in prod, but still needs rotation and containment.
Alex Park: ugh. which service?
Maria Chen: `legacy-monitor-agent` — the logging agent we deprecated. scanned the archive bucket `gs://redwood-staging-logs-archive/2025/aug/`. key file had a wrapped blob and the sa email.
Sean O'Neill: is the key material usable?
Maria Chen: the blob was an RSA-wrapped key but we can rewrap -> still risk. log shows it was used to push metrics to a third-party endpoint once. i've pulled an audit snapshot.
Irene Torres: tagging sec-oncall. need an action list: rotate, rewrap, revoke, scrub logs, RBAC lock.
Maria Chen: agreed. proposed plan: 1) create new ephemeral SA for the agent, 2) rewrap existing ciphertext under a new KMS key (to break lineage), 3) revoke the old SA keys/disable account, 4) rotate Vault path pointing to the new key, 5) scrub archived logs and annotate audit.
Alex Park: timeline? small blast window preferred. we can do rotation + IAM revoke in a 30m maintenance window.
Sean O'Neill: i can update the agent to use short-lived workload identity tokens instead of long-lived SA keys — reduces risk long-term. Monday deploy?
Maria Chen: for immediate containment, we should revoke the exposed key now. Alex, can you remove the key and create the new one? call out if you need an owner.
Alex Park: on it. creating new SA and key now. will use `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create` to generate and immediately upload to Vault.
Alex Park: command i'll run:
```
# create new key and store directly in vault (no disk persist)
TMP=$(mktemp)
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create $TMP --iam-account=legacy-monitor-agent@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com
vault write secret/agents/legacy-monitor-agent key=@$TMP
rm -f $TMP
```
Maria Chen: perfect. ensure Vault write goes to the dedicated mount with tightened ACLs (not the generic secret/). @vault-bot can you confirm the mount is `secret/agents` with explicit policy?
vault-bot: mount `secret/agents` exists. policy `agents-legacy` grants read/write to `team-monitoring` and admin to `eng-infra`. audit device enabled on file-audit-2025 for that mount.
Maria Chen: thanks. next: rewrap the exposed ciphertext under new KMS key to sever access. Alex, we'll coordinate with infra to do a rewrap rather than decrypting in the clear.
Alex Park: rewrap via KMS: `gcloud kms keys versions create` then `gcloud kms encrypt --key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/incident-2025/cryptoKeys/new-rewrap-key ...` — I'll handle.
Irene Torres: log scrubbing: i can run a redact job on the archived files. will produce a scrub report and put a checksum on the scrubbed bucket. we should keep an immutable evidence copy in a restricted bucket for the incident log.
Maria Chen: correct. move sanitized copy to `gs://redwood-incident-evidence/3289012345/` with restricted ACLs and enable object lifecycle to expire after 1y. include hash in the incident ticket.
Sean O'Neill: RBAC change: i'd like to restrict who can list keys in Vault for `secret/agents/*`. current policy allows `team-monitoring` to create keys but not list. propose we also remove `list` from `team-monitoring` for that path and only allow `eng-infra` to list.
Maria Chen: good hardening. file a PR against `vault-policies` repo and ping infra. small owners: @Alex Park will do the IAM/KMS/rewrap and Vault write, @Irene Torres will scrub logs, @Sean O'Neill will open the PR to change Vault policy and update agent to workload identity. I'll own the incident ticket and update compliance log.
Alex Park: old key revoked. IAM key deleted at `3289012400`. created new SA key and wrote to `secret/agents/legacy-monitor-agent` — access limited to `eng-infra` and CI deploy token.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: `monitor-agent-update` -> canary at 3289013200 UTC; rollback window 15m.
Maria Chen: do not roll to prod yet. this is staging-only agent. Sean, can you hold the code change to replace long-lived key with WI until next week?
Sean O'Neill: yes. will schedule the code PR for Monday and put in the canary pipeline then.
Irene Torres: scrub job completed. scrubbed files moved to `gs://redwood-incident-evidence/3289012345/` (sha256sums attached to ticket). original archived logs are now ACL-restricted and a retention flag set to 90d before purge.
Maria Chen: I'll update the compliance log and mark this medium severity (staging-only, single external call). adding post-incident items: (A) rollout WI for agents, (B) enable automatic KMS rewrap for retired keys, (C) periodic archive scans for 1y-old keys, (D) reduce Vault policy list privileges.
Irene Torres: should we trigger an org-wide scan for other legacy-agent instances?
Alex Park: yes — kicking off a query across buckets for `legacy-monitor-agent` references. will post results in this thread.
Maria Chen: thanks everyone. i'll file the final incident note and close the ticket after Alex posts the scan results and Sean opens the PR. :thumbsup:
